title: The little things did the work
intro: A scrap of paper could change the game. A memory card could hold a summer. This edition follows the small decisions behind the big memories: what to save, what to sample, what to play next.

/zones/games/.title: Know the shortcut. Keep the save.
/zones/games/.intro: Actual codes, identified demo discs and a 15-block budget. Start with what the player can do, then look at the hardware that makes it possible.

/zones/music/.title: Hear the choice inside the record
/zones/music/.intro: Follow a sample home, isolate a voice and try a timed mix. These guides begin with named recordings and leave you with something specific to hear again.

/zones/tv-movies/.title: Make an appointment with the screen
/zones/tv-movies/.intro: A dated SNICK lineup, a summer release calendar and a rental that still needs returning. Follow the film or show beyond the moment you press play.

/zones/tech-toys/.title: The machine has a particular job
/zones/tech-toys/.intro: Compare two 1996 browsers, edit on the original MiniDisc recorder and check that the file opens at the other desk. The versions are part of the story.

/zones/culture/.title: Read the label. Follow the route.
/zones/culture/.intro: FUBU’s founders, an actual mall directory and two different electronic pets. Ordinary choices become more interesting when the names and objects stay visible.

/zones/fashion/.title: The garment carries a reference
/zones/fashion/.intro: Start with FUBU’s authorship, compare the grunge runway, then put the clothes back into shops and music. A logo can begin the explanation without finishing it.

/zones/internet-culture/.title: Make a page. Leave a trace.
/zones/internet-culture/.intro: Build the invented homepage, follow its ring and preview a greeting. Then compare the browser, connection and shared desk that made visiting possible.

/zones/transparent-tech/.title: A new shell, a new routine
/zones/transparent-tech/.intro: The Bondi blue iMac changes the room and the file handoff. Compare its case with an Atomic Purple handheld and the same controller seen through a different shell.
